Name: stop_gap
Comments: top travel before it lands on the stop pads - tune after measuring cell deflection

Name: pad_h
Comments: stop pad height above the bottom face

Name: pad_r_in
Comments: stop pad inner radius

Name: pad_r_out
Comments: stop pad outer radius

Name: pad_span
Comments: angular width of each stop pad

Name: pad_count
Comments: number of stop pads (circular pattern)

Name: pad_a1
Comments: first pad centre angle from the cable line

Name: pad_pitch
Comments: angle between pads

Name: wire_ch_start
Comments: lead channel start = cell pocket edge (sketch is constrained to the pocket edge; this value only feeds splice_start)

Name: wire_ch_end
Comments: lead channel end - past the rim

Name: slack_len
Comments: loose cell-lead zone between the cell pocket and the splice pocket

Name: splice_start
Comments: splice pocket start - distance out from puck centre

Name: splice_end
Comments: splice pocket end - distance out from puck centre

Name: splice_w
Comments: splice pocket width

Name: splice_depth
Comments: splice pocket depth below bottom face

Name: cable_d
Comments: cable groove diameter (cable 4.2 nominal)

Name: cable_depth
Comments: groove centre below bottom face

Name: groove_start
Comments: groove start - distance out from puck centre

Name: clamp_start
Comments: clamp recess start - distance out from puck centre

Name: clamp_w
Comments: clamp recess width

Name: clamp_depth
Comments: clamp recess depth below bottom face (floor at Y 0)

Name: clamp_ins_d
Comments: hole for M2 x 6 x 3.5 heat-set insert

Name: clamp_ins_depth
Comments: insert hole depth below recess floor

Name: clamp_ins_x
Comments: insert offset each side of cable centreline

Name: clamp_ins_r
Comments: insert distance out from puck centre

Name: bar_t
Comments: clamp bar thickness (top flush with bottom face)

Name: bar_hole_d
Comments: M2 clearance hole in clamp bar

Name: ridge_h
Comments: clamp bar ridge height - sets cable squeeze (0.6 mm at 1.0)

Name: ridge_w
Comments: ridge width along the cable

Name: ridge_len
Comments: ridge length across the cable - must be <= cable_d so the ridges drop into the groove

Name: ridge_r1
Comments: first ridge distance out from puck centre

Name: ridge_r2
Comments: second ridge distance out from puck centre
